daily.today_energy: Saturn's trine to the Sun is basically giving you permission to be your most structured self—no apologies needed. Your ruling planet's vibe is steady and grounded right now, so lean into planning mode.
daily.love: Venus square the Moon has some feelings bubbling up, but it's not messy—just real. If you've been holding back, today's the day to say something genuine. Authenticity hits different.
daily.career: Mercury in Scorpio is helping you dig deep into details while Saturn supports your long-term vision. This is prime time for strategic moves, honest conversations with higher-ups, or finally organizing that project.
daily.health: Your body's asking for routine and discipline—which honestly suits you perfectly. A solid workout, clean eating, and an early bedtime will feel genuinely nourishing, not restrictive.

weekly.overview: This week hits different for you, Cap. The Sun's square to Mars early on creates friction that'll test your patience, but stick with it—by Friday, the Sun trines Saturn and you'll feel that steady grind actually paying off. Best Day: Friday. Watch-Out Day: Tuesday. The Moon glides from Taurus through Gemini into Leo, keeping you mentally sharp but emotionally restless.
weekly.love: Venus sextiles Jupiter midweek, sprinkling some genuine warmth into your connections. If you've been holding back, this is your window to show up more authentically. Single? Someone intriguing could cross your path, but don't overthink the signals. By weekend, the Leo Moon softens things—just be real and you'll vibe.
weekly.career: Early week feels like pushing uphill with that Sun-Mars tension, but here's the thing: you're actually building something solid. Mars slides into Virgo later in the week, sharpening your execution. That detail-oriented energy? Peak performance mode activated. Friday's Sun-Saturn trine is your green light to present ideas or ask for what you deserve.
weekly.health: The Taurus Moon start of week craves grounding—yoga, long walks, something tangible. Mid-to-late week energy spikes thanks to Mars-Jupiter action, so channel that into movement. Don't burn out by cramming everything in. Rest matters. By Saturday, you'll want to reset; honor that instinct instead of pushing through.
